title: 旗印 — Aurefold の世界を形づくる読者たちに加わろう
description: 旗印は Aurefold の読者が集う場所。誓いを立て、家門を選び、合議で票を投じ、自らのキャラクターを立て、写字室に作品を残そう。
blocks: In the hall already: Yara Cobbleworth of Stormrider, Corin Farrow of Ashbourne, and Old Ferro of Ironvale — sworn and honoured.
広間にはすでに：Stormrider の Yara Cobbleworth、Ashbourne の Corin Farrow、Ironvale の Old Ferro——誓いを立て、栄誉を受けた者たち。
Lately: the theory “Why the Chronicle and the Ash Fragments Can't Both Be Lying,” and the story “A Night at the Toll House.”
最近の作品：考察 “Why the Chronicle and the Ash Fragments Can't Both Be Lying” と物語 “A Night at the Toll House”。
Standing now: “Which house would you follow?” and “Which house's fragment does the archive read aloud next?”
いま立っている問い：“Which house would you follow?” と “Which house's fragment does the archive read aloud next?”
